task_description.overview: Generate a histogram-style plot showing the number of earthquakes per magnitude bin to assess catalog completeness and estimate b-value.
steps: Define magnitude bin width (fmd_bin) for histogram.
Compute the frequency of events in each magnitude bin.
Plot the histogram with optional styling parameters (color, size, label).
Return or save the figure for analysis.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Statistic the frequency-magnitude distribution. Loading the earthquake catalog at {catalog_path}, bin the magnitudes with bin width {fmd_bin}, statistic the frequency-magnitude distribution and plot the frequency-magnitude distribution. 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary provide some functions to do catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please refer to the `seismostats` provide some functions to assist. 
 2) Save the fmd plot to {result_plot} and the fmd data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content}.
